Maps and location: geocoding, directions, styles, tilesets and datasets.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [console.mapbox.com](https://console.mapbox.com/account/access-tokens/)
- **Setting:** `MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [docs.mapbox.com](https://docs.mapbox.com/api/overview/)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Mapbox and open [console.mapbox.com](https://console.mapbox.com/account/access-tokens/).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** An access token from Access tokens in the Mapbox console, with only the scopes the app needs; the Gateway adds it to every call as the access\_token parameter.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Mapbox) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
everyapp secret set MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  mapbox: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"` (or `"write"` where it changes things). The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `everyapp provider show mapbox` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** Per token and per API: Geocoding 1,000 a minute, Directions 300, Static Images 1,250; the Tokens API 100 a minute per account.
